# `/connectors` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /connectors/v1/{scriptName}

`getConnectorV1` — Get connector by script name

Fetches a connector that using its script name.

- Scopes: idn:connector-config:manage, idn:connector-config:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `scriptName` (path, required) — The scriptName value of the connector. ScriptName is the unique id generated at connector creation.
  - `locale` (query) — one of de, no, fi, sv, ru, pt, ko, zh-TW, en, it, fr, zh-CN, hu, es, cs, ja, pl, da, nl — The locale to apply to the config. If no viable locale is given, it will default to "en"
- Returns 200: connectordetail

### DELETE /connectors/v1/{scriptName}

`deleteCustomConnectorV1` — Delete connector by script name

Delete a custom connector that using its script name.

- Scopes: idn:connector-config:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `scriptName` (path, required) — The scriptName value of the connector. ScriptName is the unique id generated at connector creation.
- Returns 204: no body

### PATCH /connectors/v1/{scriptName}

`updateConnectorV1` — Update connector by script name

This API updates a custom connector by script name using [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) syntax. The following fields are patchable: * connectorMetadata * applicationXml * correlationConfigXml * sourceConfigXml

- Scopes: idn:connector-config:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `scriptName` (path, required) — The scriptName value of the connector. ScriptName is the unique id generated at connector creation.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: connectordetail

### GET /connectors/v1

`getConnectorListV1` — Get connector list

Fetches list of connectors that have 'RELEASED' status using filtering and pagination.

- Scopes: idn:connector-config:manage, idn:connector-config:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: name: sw, co; type: sw, co, eq; directConnect: eq; category: eq; features: ca; labels: ca — e.g. `directConnect eq "true"`
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `locale` (query) — one of de, no, fi, sv, ru, pt, ko, zh-TW, en, it, fr, zh-CN, hu, es, cs, ja, pl, da, nl — The locale to apply to the config. If no viable locale is given, it will default to "en"
- Returns 200: array of v3connectordto

### POST /connectors/v1

`createCustomConnectorV1` — Create custom connector

Create custom connector.

- Scopes: idn:connector-config:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): v3createconnectordto
